d: InnovationTeam is seeking a hands-on HR professional with comprehensive HR knowledge and capabilities expected of an HR Manager. Reporting to the current HR Manager, you will support approximately 400 employees, with planned hiring of more than 100 additional employees and further growth expected across our IT services and project-based business.
q: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
At least two years of experience in an HR management role or as a Senior HR Specialist, with practical exposure across core HR functions.
Experience in IT, technology services, systems integration, or project-based organizations is preferred.
Experience supporting a workforce of several hundred employees is preferred.
Sound knowledge of Saudi labor regulations, Saudization, relevant government platforms, and HR management systems.
Ability to analyze workforce data and costs and provide clear, practical recommendations.
Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills, with a hands-on approach and effective coordination across divisions.
High standards of confidentiality, professional judgment, and integrity.
Proficiency in spoken and written English.
Relevant professional HR certifications are preferred.
r: Support HR strategy, workforce planning, organizational structures, job descriptions, and budgets in line with business and project needs.
Lead the assigned HR operations team, allocate responsibilities, and ensure employee requests are handled accurately within agreed service timelines.
Coordinate recruitment and assess local, overseas, and outsourced staffing options based on quality, cost, and availability.
Manage onboarding, probation, employee transfers, and offboarding, coordinating timely joining and smooth transitions to support project continuity.
Maintain employee records, contracts, leave, and attendance; reconcile attendance records and validate payroll inputs with Finance.
Proactively track contract renewals, probation deadlines, and employee documentation and government requirements, coordinating timely completion with the responsible teams.
Support salary structures, benefits, incentives, and compensation reviews to maintain fairness and competitiveness.
Coordinate performance management, improvement plans, promotions, training, career development, and succession planning.
Handle employee relations, grievances, and disciplinary matters fairly and confidentially; maintain practical HR policies and consistent compliance with Saudi labor regulations.
Support Saudization and Saudi talent development through university partnerships, internships, and graduate programs.
Strengthen engagement, internal communication, employer branding, and inclusion across a diverse workforce working in offices, at client sites, and remotely.
Monitor turnover, identify retention risks early, and coordinate practical actions to retain critical talent.
Improve HR systems and workflows, and report on service quality, workforce costs, staffing, and compliance. Work with relevant divisions to review bench costs and recommend improvements.

d: Fives Services Gulf is actively seeking an Execution Director to join its teams in the Gulf region.
At Fives, we are all driven by a common calling, to prove that industry can do it!
We work together daily to make industry an answer to all of the major technological, environmental, social and economic challenges of our time.
For over 200 years, we’ve invented and designed solutions and technologies that substantially and sustainably improve everyone’s daily life.

Fives Services Gulf is the Fives service Centre for the Middle East, with a team of 160 people based in Bahrain, UAE and Saudi Arabia, Fives Services Gulf provides local customer service, project execution support and local parts sourcing, in addition to carrying out refit and modernization projects, audits and technical assistance on customer sites. A team is also dedicated to the maintenance of equipment in operation at our customers' plants.

We are committed, fulfilled and give meaning to our mission, which is to work together to develop new solutions for the industry of tomorrow: an industry that respects the environment and helps to make the world a better place.
It is with you, that industry can do it!

Fives Services Gulf (FSG) is recruiting for an experienced Execution Director to lead the delivery of Engineering, Supply Chain activities and Projects related to Fives Services Gulf. The position will oversee the project, engineering and supply chain teams located in Bahrain and the UAE.

The role requires a strong leader capable of managing technical project execution, overseeing the delivery of all projects and operational activities in alignment with FSG’s strategic and operational objectives. This role holds full accountability for Engineering, Supply Chain and Project Execution within Fives Services Gulf. The position requires managing multiple complex projects simultaneously, often with overlapping timelines and varying client and technical requirements.
This position reports directly to the Managing Director for the Gulf Region and plays a critical role in connecting sales, projects, spare parts and HSEQ across the Gulf region.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (Master’s degree preferred).
10+ years of experience in project execution and engineering services, preferably in the aluminum or heavy industrial sectors.
Proven leadership experience managing distributed teams.
Strong understanding of project execution services and customer support in an aluminum industry setting (Potroom cranes and Green Anode Plant).
Ability to manage cross-border operations and frequent travel between the UAE and Bahrain (50/50 time split).
Fluent in English; French proficiency is an advantage.
Frequent regional/international travel will be required.

By becoming part of Fives, you will join an international group offering access to a wide range of growth and mobility opportunities. We provide an environment where you can learn, grow, and develop both professionally and personally.
r: Provide strategic direction and technical oversight for all engineering activities to ensure alignment with project requirements, safety standards, and client specifications.
Ensure manuals and technical documents are regularly updated and shared to equip users with the necessary knowledge to execute tasks safely and efficiently.
Identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities within engineering workflows to enhance productivity and quality.
Foster a strong relationship with the Product Offices Engineering teams (based abroad).

Identify areas for automation and digitization to drive efficiencies in day-to-day working practices and lead the implementation of automation/digitization strategies and solutions for the Execution department to drive continuous improvement and enhance the department’s capabilities and service offering.
Responsible for overseeing the execution of projects and ensuring delivery is in line with the technical scope, specifications, budgets, timelines, and regulatory standards.
Oversee the project execution teams based in the Gulf, ensuring effective remote collaboration.
Ensure project activities align with customer expectations, FSG safety standards and quality requirements.
Collaborate with spare parts and workshop teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
Oversee purchasing and logistics for Fives Services Gulf, ensuring spare parts procurement and delivery align with operational and strategic requirements.
Manage stock requirements, inventory, replenishment, and availability of resources to support operational needs.
Participate in the development of quotations, bids, and technical evaluations to support tendering and bidding processes.
Develop strategies to ensure the department meets operational requirements to support company objectives.

Responsible for defining, developing and implementing the operating framework and policies and procedures for the Execution Department and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, Fives standards and international best practices.

Responsible for overseeing the planning, scheduling and execution of daily operations of the department to ensure that work/tasks are performed accurately and efficiently in conformance with established methods, instructions and quality standards, and results are reported in a timely manner as per Company policies and procedures and/or customer requirements.
Develop and create the required strategies to ensure the department can meet the operational requirements of Fives Services Gulf to support achievement of operational and strategic objectives.
Responsible for managing, reviewing and monitoring the financial performance of the department including but not limited to managing the P&L and developing CAPEX and OPEX budgets.
Participate in the candidate selection process and ensure all recruitment activities within area of responsibility are completed as per Fives Services Gulf recruitment policies and procedures.
Set and agree individual goals for all direct reports and evaluate individual performance providing regular feedback and coaching in line with Fives people management practices.
Ensure compliance with all relevant (internal and external) regulations including HSEQ requirements using Company policies and procedures as appropriate.

Responsible for developing and implementing plans for cost reduction and driving efficient and effective practices and procedures to continuously improve and enhance the department’s capabilities and operations.
Establish and maintain a strong rapport with key customers in the Gulf.
Act as the primary point of contact for customers in the UAE regarding project execution and service delivery.
Working closely with the sales team, support business development efforts by identifying local opportunities and ensuring customer satisfaction.
Represent the company in local meetings, technical discussions, and commercial negotiations.

Direct reports include Project Supervisors, Project Managers and other project execution roles. Dotted line reports include Business Development Managers, Spare Part Coordinators, HR Roles and administrative staff.
Foster a strong team spirit, ensuring collaboration across functions and a sense of belonging.
Ensure effective communication and integration between the project team located in the Gulf.
Provide regular updates and performance reports on projects, team activities, and customer relations.
Successful and timely execution of projects and engineering services across FSG operations.
Customer satisfaction and relationship development in the Gulf countries.
Effective leadership and cohesion of the Execution team.
Contribution to business development and local market presence.
Maintaining high standards of operational excellence, safety, and compliance.
Hands-on and pragmatic leader with a proactive attitude.
Strategic thinker with a focus on operational execution.
High level of cultural sensitivity and adaptability.
PMP or equivalent project management certification is preferred.
Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply (CIPS) certification is preferred.

d: Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

We are seeking an experienced and collaborative Manager, People Operations to lead the People function in Qatar. This role combines strategic partnership with operational leadership, ensuring our people, leaders and businesses have the support, capability and environment needed to achieve their goals. You'll play a key role in shaping culture, driving organisational effectiveness, building leadership capability and creating an exceptional employee experience.

Lead the end-to-end delivery of People Operations activities across Qatar, ensuring high-quality, compliant and commercially focused HR services that support business performance and project delivery.

Partner with business leaders to understand workforce priorities, organisational challenges and future capability requirements, developing practical people solutions that support business growth and operational effectiveness.
Drive the execution of Worley's people strategy within Qatar, ensuring alignment between local business needs, regional priorities and enterprise-wide people initiatives.

Act as a trusted advisor and coach to leaders on organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, leadership capability, employee relations, performance management, succession planning and change management.
Lead local people initiatives and projects that enhance employee experience, strengthen organisational capability, improve workforce effectiveness and support sustainable business growth.

Collaborate with COEs including Talent Acquisition, Reward, Talent Management, Mobility and remuneration and benefits and digital execution to deliver integrated people solutions and ensure successful implementation of enterprise programmes within the business.
Oversee employee relations matters, workplace accountability processes and people risk management activities, ensuring fair, consistent and legally compliant outcomes.
Lead workforce planning and talent discussions, ensuring the business has the capability, succession pipelines and talent strategies required to meet current and future operational demands.
Champion employee engagement, inclusion, wellbeing, culture and retention initiatives that strengthen Worley's Employee Value Proposition and support a high-performing workplace.
Oversee local compliance requirements, including employment legislation, visas, immigration, professional registrations, business licensing obligations and associated governance requirements.
Use workforce insights, people data and business trends to identify risks and opportunities, influencing decision-making and supporting the achievement of business objectives.
Partner with Shared Services and COEs to continuously improve processes, service delivery and employee experience while ensuring effective governance and operational efficiency.
Lead and support organisational change initiatives, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement, communication, readiness and adoption.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement, ensuring that Worley's values are embedded in everyday leadership and people practices.
q: We're looking for an experienced People leader who combines strong HR operational expertise, strategic business partnering capability and a demonstrated ability to deliver people outcomes in a complex, fast-paced environment. You will be comfortable balancing hands-on operational delivery with longer-term workforce planning, organisational effectiveness and people initiatives that support business growth.
Chartered CIPD qualification or equivalent professional HR accreditation.
Experience supporting large-scale projects, engineering, energy, chemicals or resources sector businesses.
Experience leading organisation design, restructuring, workforce transformation or culture change programmes.

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
r: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Social Sciences or a related discipline.

Minimum 10 years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant experience partnering with senior business leaders and leading broad HR generalist activities across multiple people disciplines.
Demonstrated experience leading People Operations within a complex, project-based, engineering, professional services or industrial environment.

Strong knowledge and practical application of workforce planning, talent acquisition, talent management, succession planning, performance management, employee relations, organisational development and change management.
Proven ability to translate business strategy into practical people plans that improve organisational capability, workforce effectiveness and business performance.
Experience partnering with senior leaders to address organisational challenges, manage workforce risks and support business transformation initiatives.
Sound understanding of Qatar employment legislation, labour practices, immigration requirements and associated regulatory frameworks. Knowledge of wider GCC employment practices is desirable.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build credibility, influence decisions and effectively partner across a matrix organisation.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex employee relations matters, workplace investigations, organisational change activities and business-critical people initiatives.
Experience collaborating with Centres of Expertise and Shared Services teams to successfully deliver integrated people solutions and enterprise-wide programmes.
Strong analytical and commercial acumen with the ability to interpret workforce data, identify trends, assess risks and make evidence-based recommendations.
Excellent coaching, consulting, facilitation, influencing and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organisation.
Experience managing multiple priorities while delivering high-quality outcomes in a dynamic and changing environment.
Commitment to fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture aligned to Worley's values and employee value proposition.
